author: darkkrun
quote: Graphics and exploration are good, but 30 fps makes it less enjoyable. Many characters are cool but the main protagonists are boring and forgettable. The story is mediocre, many dialogues are badly written and its not as funny as in the previous game. Feels watered down tbh. Had some annoying bugs dat forced me to restart the game. Ill  js wait for pc.

author: darkkrun
quote: Got Exactly what I wanted from this game. I faithful remake that improves on the game mechanics lacking in the original game. Battles are so smooth, everything looks great and the exploration is fun. Love the dungeons.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
